compound_identity.formulation_limit: Hospital-pharmacy preparations. Main calls metformin tablets; protocols call capsules. No monotherapy arms; no arbitrary retail-product transfer.

population.setting: single-center Basel, ambulant at least150m and MFM-D1 at least40%
population.exclusion_interpretation: transfer limits, not patient-specific contraindication determination

principal_conclusion: Overall week26 primary inconclusive; retain week13 strength/distal-function nominal positives, planned stable-subgroup signal and slower MRI worsening. No monotherapy, BUBR1 restoration or MVA efficacy claim.

primary.interpretation: less decline point estimate, not confirmed overall benefit

positive_contexts: Week26 stable-walker MFM-D1+6.7 points (.9,12.6), P.03; interaction P.67
Week26 MRI FF/T2 slower worsening, P.04/.02
decisive_limits: Overall primary P.09; week26 strength/MFM-D3 and walking/timed outcomes nonsignificant.
Stable versus unstable treatment interaction P.67; steroids interaction P.20.
No reported correction for multiple secondary/visit/subgroup comparisons.
45 study completers versus43 complete primary cases; multiple imputation retains47.
No achieved exposure/numerical adherence result found.
3 source-labeled severe AEs on active versus0, including2 fractures; causality not established.
Early versus final significance difference is not a proven treatment-by-time difference.

prespecification.supplied_protocol: Version8, September2015, Wilcoxon/LOCF; threshold not documented in statistical section
prespecification.published_protocol: PMID27488051, August2016, ANCOVA and350m subgroup explicitly planned, secondary endpoints hypothesis-generating; LOCF
prespecification.remaining_gap: Published after trial completion; independently dated finalSAP and historical registry versions not obtained. Source uses>350 versus publication>=350. Not relabeled post hoc.

biomarker_resolution: UrineNEAA between-arm P.09 at26wk and.08 at13wk despite Discussion significance claim. Week13 GGT P.02; no week26 listed biomarker significant. No direct NO/mitochondrial or BUB1B mechanism established.

bub1b.scope: No such assay reported in complete2019 scientific main/scientific supplement; not a universal biological absence claim.

competitive_assessment.niacin: More direct randomized pediatric early functional evidence than the appraised open-label niacin strength result; different from its provisional NAD/SIRT2/BUBR1 restoration hypothesis. No selective MVA-efficacy requirement imposed.
competitive_assessment.apitegromab: Does not currently displace recorded positive primary pediatricSMA motor-function evidence; comparison is not measured cross-trial superiority.
competitive_assessment.recommendation: Visible combination-specific functional reserve; no automatic nominee replacement; preserve prior-27 and old metformin/AICAR rationale.

source_reviewer_status: source qualification; external only, optional admission left to root
